summary: Florence County fire tower at Halls Lake, listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no source found gives its history or what remains today.

facts.status_note: Listed as Gone on the Forest Fire Lookout Association's Wisconsin list. No other source found describes this tower.

evidence.supports: Halls Lake tower in Florence County, at the listed coordinates, marked as gone

notes_for_editor: The only source found is the list row. Two web searches for Halls Lake returned no history of this tower. A Florence County museum feature seen only as a search snippet names five county towers (Buckeye, Florence, Long Lake, Newald and Bass Lake), and none is called Halls Lake. That feature was not read as a page and is not cited, so Halls Lake may be a local name for one of them, but this is unverified. The story is about 55 words, below the 120-word floor. The editor may hold it or accept it as a stub. Better sources to try in a later run: the Florence County Historical Society or Museum and the Wisconsin Historical Society architecture inventory.
